notes: The plan shows the warehouse blocks drawn sideways on the page. The array is three blocks across the page and four down it. Its side along the page's left edge lies within about 0.5 m of the drawn podium edge, and its side along the page's lower edge about 3.5 m from the oblique line; in the image the grid of blocks lies within about 0.5 m of the platform's north edge and about 4-5 m from its west edge. The page's left side was therefore matched to north and the page's lower side to west, which is a rotation without mirroring; the plan's north arrow was not used for this. The visible grid is nearly square (about 14 x 13 m) while the drawn array is 13.6 x 17.5 m, so the east-west extent is the least certain; the drawn east blocks are partly shaded lightly, which may mark brickwork that is not exposed today. The object spans about 20 m, so the fit's rotation is expected to be weakly constrained. Points are read on the same 2023-08 Wayback mosaic as the Fig. 10.10 A registration. The check rejects this link because the fitted scale is 0.84 of the scale bar; that matches the short east-west extent of the visible grid described above, and no point was moved for it.
